name: Yoshizawa Eigen
source:
The head doctor of the clinic where Miyuri works at. He is the father of Takeo. He was once the attending physician of Akito's and Kazuto's parents when they were admitted to the hospital.

[spoiler]Side Story- coerces Miyuri to have sex with him and she gets captured by his attacks[/spoiler]
